Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, there lived a boy named Tim and his pet dog, Spot. They loved to play outside in the big yard near their house.
One day, Tim and Spot were playing near the mountain when they heard a strange noise. It sounded like someone was growling. They were scared and didn't know what to do. They stopped and listened carefully. The noise was coming from behind a tree.
Tim and Spot walked to the tree and saw a little bird. The bird was hurt and couldn't fly. Tim and Spot decided to help the bird. They took it outside and let it look at its wing. The bird started to sing a beautiful song. The song made the bird feel better.
The bird was so happy that it sang a beautiful song. Tim and Spot felt good for helping the bird. Then, Spot went back to the house and Tim sang a happy song. They had a great day and felt good for helping their new friend.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her soft toy cat. She would squeeze it and hug it tight when she was happy.
One day, Lucy's little brother, Tim, wanted to play with his new toy car too. "Can I play with your car, Tim?" he asked. Lucy didn't want to share, but she knew it was an truth. "No, Tim! I will not share my toy car with you, so I won't play with you," she said.
Tim was sad, but he knew Lucy was right. He thought about it and said, "Okay, we can play together with your toy car." Lucy was happy, and they played together all day. From that day on, Lucy made sure to keep her best friend safe and had lots of fun together.
